Take my yoke upon you, and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart; and you will find rest for your souls.

translations.web: Return to your rest, my soul, for Yahweh has dealt bountifully with you.
translations.bsb: Return to your rest, O my soul, for the LORD has been good to you.
translations.kjv: Return unto thy rest, O my soul; for the LORD hath dealt bountifully
translations.asv: Return unto thy rest, O my soul; For Jehovah hath dealt bountifully with thee.
